blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Helps You Find Out if Your Company is Eligible for Financial Assistance from the U.S. Small Business Administration

You company might be eligible to seek loans, grants, and other forms of funding from the U.S. Small Business Administration. This source of financial assistance can be used to help with cash flow, to fund research and development, to pay for equipment or facility improvements, or a number of other business endeavors. Most businesses are eligible to apply for this kind of financial help, but there are certain restrictions.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://reliancecpa.com) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help your company develop a budget that will put it on the path to profitability. One of our experienced business consultants can also help you determine whether you are eligible for financial assistance from the U.S. Small Business Administration, if you would like to apply. In general, financial assistance is available for companies that:

items.text: Are engaged in, or propose to do business in, the U.S. or its possessions
Have reasonable owner equity to invest
Have already used or sought alternative financing options, including personal assets, to raise capital

blocks.text: No matter what your company might need capital for, whether it is to invest in growth or to streamline cash flow, a business consultant from Reliance can help you determine how best to go about acquiring the financing you need for your business. Reliance also can help you set a budget, plan your taxes, handle your payroll, and anything else related to your company’s finances.
